verdict.rationale: First-party DGX B200 docs describe an 8-GPU system with 5th-generation NVLink switches providing 14.4 TB/s aggregate bandwidth, plus cluster and data-center-level management, a turnkey SuperPOD data-center offering, and multi-node training (NeMo) and serving (NIM). Hands-on community reports corroborate the NVLink/NVSwitch fabric under Fabric Manager in HGX B200 deployments. Missing for 10: rack-scale deployment covered only by a one-line SuperPOD marketing claim, and no documented inter-node networking specs (InfiniBand appears only as an unvalidated community remark).

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can train and serve at datacenter scale on this part — documented high-bandwidth interconnect (NVLink, Infinity Fabric), multi-GPU systems, and rack-scale deployment

8 x NVIDIA B200 GPUs that provide 1,440 GB total GPU memory
